candidates.description: This feature vector represents the concept of fantasy, imagination, and unreal or magical phenomena.
This feature vector represents verbs and nouns associated with making assertions, arguments, or cognitive claims.
Adverbs used to restrict, qualify, or modify the degree and exactness of a statement.
This vector represents subjective adjectives and nouns expressing strong emotional evaluation, intensity, or moral weight.
This vector represents enthusiastic supporters, followers, and dedicated audiences of a public figure, team, or brand.
This feature vector activates on concepts, relationships, and terminology associated with similarity, comparison, and likeness.
This vector represents the concept of morality, ethics, and spiritual or religious faith.
This vector represents the concept of social or formal rejection, refusal, and exclusion.
This feature vector represents human languages, linguistic terms, and spoken communication.
This vector represents concepts related to directional change, magnitude, or fluctuation over time.
